A.notes: The shared receipt slip and its accumulating ledger lines give all four pages a coherent object to follow. Directional View Transitions, line-by-line reveals, reduced-motion fades, and a working instant-navigation fallback make the motion feel tied to the tour. Strong type and responsive structure are supported by local fonts and accessible focus handling.

hard_gates: Body text contrast: --ink-3 (#6f756f) on --paper (#f5f2ea) is below 4.5:1; it is used for text such as card subtitles and step labels.
B.notes: The persistent balance card and progress indicator create a clear through-line, and the billing control adds useful interaction on Pricing. Its View Transitions and Lottie animations have reduced-motion handling and directional behavior, though the overall card-based presentation feels more like a polished SaaS template than a distinctive visual idea. The low-contrast muted text fails a hard gate; external font loading is also less performance-friendly than A’s local fonts.

result.reason: A carries its distinctive receipt idea through the tour with stronger narrative motion and avoids the body-text contrast hard-gate failure present in B.
